_note: The DSX Scene PROJECTION corpus (dsx-scene.md P1). THE LAW: the view matrix is right-handed lookAt (f = normalize(target−eye), s = normalize(f×up), u = s×f, up = +Y), the projection is the GL convention — perspective(fovY degrees, aspect, near, far) with NDC z ∈ [-1,1], and mode="2d" is ORTHOGRAPHIC with `size` = the vertical HALF-extent (half-width = size·aspect) — the same graph, z as layer order. ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w with clip = P · V · [world,1]. Camera defaults (the parse corpus pins them too): position "0 0 5", look-at "0 0 0", fov 60, near 0.1, far 1000, size 5. Case shape: `camera` (authored words incl. aspect, which the element takes from its canvas) + `points` = [{world, ndc}] at 6 decimals. Expected numbers were computed by an independent scratch implementation, never by the kernel under test. Runners: TS (per-PR); Kotlin/Swift are the P2 row of dsx-scene.md.
